text: Roots and `include_modules` shall select modules unconditionally; every selected object's import locks shall recursively select exact providers until finite closure. Provider ambiguity/duplicate ownership shall fail. Selection shall be independent of input order and shall include type-only/constant-only imports. Unselected library entries shall contribute no lifecycle/code effects.
